title: PeopleSoft Integration Developer
description:
Peoplesoft Integration Developer - Remote

Bright Vision Technologies is a technology consulting and software development company delivering cloud, AI, data, and enterprise solutions across the United States.
This is a fantastic opportunity to join an established and well-respected organization offering tremendous career growth potential.

Job Title: Peoplesoft Integration Developer
Location: 100% Remote (U.S.)
Position Type: Full-time, Direct W2
Salary Range: $100,000-$150,000 Annually
Experience Required: 12+ years

Sponsorship: U.S. Citizens, Green Card Holders, EAD Holders, and H-1B transfer candidates are encouraged to apply. We are unable to sponsor new H-1B visa petitions for this position.

Job Summary:
We are seeking an experienced PeopleSoft Integration Developer to design, build, and operate enterprise integrations connecting PeopleSoft applications to internal systems, cloud applications, and third-party platforms. This role focuses specifically on the integration layer, including service operations, queues, routings, transformations, security configurations, and error handling. The ideal candidate will combine deep hands-on Integration Broker experience with broader PeopleTools knowledge and a strong understanding of API and integration design patterns. In this role you will work closely with cross-functional partners - product, design, engineering, operations, and business stakeholders - to translate ambiguous requirements into well-engineered solutions, and will be expected to raise the bar through code review, design review, and mentorship of more junior engineers. The successful candidate brings strong engineering discipline, a clear communication style, and a track record of shipping meaningful work that holds up well in production.

Key Responsibilities

• Design and develop integration scenarios using PeopleSoft Integration Broker, including service operations, queues, routings, and handlers.

• Build synchronous and asynchronous integrations using REST and SOAP web services.

• Develop transformations using XSLT, Application Engine, and PeopleCode handlers, applying disciplined engineering practices and partnering closely with stakeholders to ensure outcomes are durable, well-documented, and aligned with broader team and platform standards.

• Configure security on inbound and outbound services, including WS-Security, OAuth2, and certificate-based authentication.

• Build robust error-handling and retry mechanisms, including notifications, monitoring, and resubmission workflows.

• Develop Component Interfaces and File Layouts to support hybrid integration scenarios.

• Lead migration efforts to retire legacy point-to-point integrations to standardized Integration Broker patterns, planning phased cutovers, building backward-compatibility shims where needed, and ensuring each migration step is reversible and well-monitored.

• Optimize performance of high-volume integrations through queue tuning, parallel processing, and asynchronous design.

• Integrate PeopleSoft with cloud applications (Oracle Cloud, Workday, ServiceNow) and middleware (OIC, MuleSoft, Boomi).

• Maintain comprehensive, current technical documentation - including architecture diagrams, design decisions, configuration references, runbooks, and operational procedures - so that the system remains supportable, auditable, and easy to onboard new engineers onto over time.

• Provide hypercare and post-go-live support, including incident response and root-cause analysis.

• Collaborate closely with functional consultants and integration architects, gathering requirements, aligning on technical approach, and ensuring that delivered solutions meet both functional needs and broader engineering and operational standards.

• Mentor and coach junior and mid-level engineers through code review, design review, pair programming, and structured knowledge sharing, helping the broader team grow in technical maturity and confidence over time.

title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer, AI Platform & Agentic Apps
tags: ENG Data and AI Platform Division
description:
Join us in building the future of finance.

Our mission is to democratize finance for all. An estimated $124 trillion of assets will be inherited by younger generations in the next two decades. The largest transfer of wealth in human history. If you’re ready to be at the epicenter of this historic cultural and financial shift, keep reading.

ABOUT THE TEAM + ROLE

We are building an elite team, applying frontier technologies to the world's biggest financial problems. We're looking for bold thinkers. Sharp problem-solvers. Builders who are wired to make an impact. Robinhood isn't a place for complacency, it's where ambitious people do the best work of their careers. We're a high-performing, fast-moving team with ethics at the center of everything we do. Expectations are high, and so are the rewards.

The AI Platform & Agentic Apps team builds the agent platform behind every AI agent at Robinhood. Today it gives a growing number of engineers and employees an AI teammate that ships code, queries data, and runs operational workflows on their behalf. We're building toward the same platform powering the agents millions of customers interact with directly, in real time. These agents don't just answer questions - they're designed to take real action across carefully curated meta harnesses. This is agentic AI at real scale, in a regulated financial environment, and it will change how Robinhood works!

As a Staff Machine Learning Engineer on the AI Platform & Agentic Apps team, you will design and build the harness that every agent at Robinhood runs on. A critical part of the role is making those agents trustworthy at scale: trajectory-level evals that measure how an agent reasons and acts, and action guardrails - permission models, approval gates, and sandboxing - built as platform primitives that other teams adopt. You'll be a technical anchor on a growing, high-caliber team, collaborating with product, infrastructure, and fellow ML engineers to take ambitious ideas from zero to one and into production. You'll help define the team's technical direction, mentor engineers, and shape how Robinhood decides an agent is ready to ship. This role offers a rare combination of technical depth, platform-scale impact, and the satisfaction of building systems that genuinely don't exist anywhere else.

This role is based in our Menlo Park, CA office, with in-person attendance expected at least 3 days per week.

At Robinhood, we believe in the power of in-person work to accelerate progress, spark innovation, and strengthen community. Our office experience is intentional, energizing, and designed to fully support high-performing teams.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

• Design and build the core of Robinhood's agent harness - orchestration, tool integrations, context and memory management - so one platform can safely power both high-trust internal agents and tightly scoped customer-facing ones.

• Ship agentic applications end to end on that harness, from an ambiguous problem to a production agent that takes real action on behalf of employees or customers, and feed what you learn back into the platform.

• Build trajectory-level evaluation systems that score how an agent got to an answer, not just the answer - tool-call correctness, planning and recovery, multi-step task completion - backed by simulation environments and synthetic task generation.

Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

Anthropic's RL Scaling Science team studies how reinforcement learning behaves as we scale it (across model size, compute, and task horizon) and turns that understanding into the training recipes behind our frontier models. As a Research Engineer on this team, you'll design and run large-scale experiments to understand and resolve bottlenecks, build the benchmarks that make long-horizon progress measurable, and ship validated findings directly into production training.

This role lives at the boundary between research and engineering. The problems are open, the experiments run at frontier scale, and the path from a robust result to production is short.

• Design, run, and interpret large-scale RL experiments, reasoning rigorously about what the data does and doesn't show

• Build and maintain benchmarks for long-horizon RL so progress is measurable and reproducible

• Translate validated findings into production training recipes, exercising judgment about when a result is robust enough to ship

• Debug complex issues at the seam where research meets infrastructure - failures that only appear at scale

Real innovation starts with a strong foundation, and at commercetools, that comes from the perfect balance of our product and our people.

Behind every leap forward is a collective of builders, explorers, doers, makers, and problem-solvers.The kind of people who not only pioneered a more flexible approach to commerce architecture but also shaped the culture of experimentation that approach unlocked. Together, they are the engine of commerce innovation today.

At commercetools, we power the next era of commerce for our customers. Whether it’s AI-driven solutions that help enterprises make smarter business decisions, bridging digital and physical shopping experiences, or enabling entirely new ways for industries to connect with their customers, we help the world’s most ambitious companies experiment, scale, and grow without limits.

Here, the best idea wins, not the loudest voice. You will have the tools, trust, and space to not only build the future of commerce but to build your own.

Your Impact

As a Senior Search Engineer on our Discovery Team , you will build the retrieval layer behind product discovery for some of the world’s most demanding commerce brands.

Search is changing shape. Shoppers type full sentences instead of keywords, and increasingly the client calling our API is an AI agent rather than a person. We are on the path to take our semantic and hybrid retrieval to general availability, and tackling the hard problems: making it fast, affordable, measurably better across enterprise catalogs, and working out what comes after it. You would join that work at every layer, from query understanding down to the vector index and the cost of a single query.

You will:

• Design and implement search functionalities in a PaaS ecommerce Scala backend.

• Develop in a scalable and multi-tenant architecture.

• Analyze user needs and discuss technical approaches.

• Test software components regarding usability, functionality, and performance, and work closely with Product Management and DevOps.

• Take part in on-call rotations with a worldwide distributed team for production systems

This role is hybrid, with three days a week spent in our Munich, Berlin, London or Valencia office. 

What Sets You Apart

You're a creative problem-solver who is wired to find solutions. You confidently dive into complex challenges and have a talent for making them simple for others. Your curiosity drives you to constantly grow and contribute to an environment of trust and teamwork.

Great ideas come from many paths, and your unique perspective matters more than checking every box. What matters most is the mindset you bring to the work.

You bring:

• 5+ years of experience as a Software Engineer working in search.

• Experience with building search solutions on top of engines, such as Elasticsearch (preferred), Solr, OpenSearch, or similar.

• Aspiration to constantly improve yourself and learn new technologies, concepts, etc.

• Fluent English communication skills to work in international teams.

• AI Aptitude : A genuine curiosity for using AI tools to work smarter and more effectively, paired with a drive to learn and put them into practice in your role.

Nice to Have:  

• Experience using modern search stacks and strategies to optimize search relevance (Vector and Hybrid Search, Learning to rank, Re-ranker)

• Experience developing REST APIs and knowledge of scalable event-driven architectures (incl., queues, notification topics, sharding, replication, load balancing, and failover).

• Experience working with Scala or other functional programming languages.

• Experience with infrastructure work and other technologies like Helm, Kubernetes, and Rust. 

Our Benefits

Because work and life are connected, our benefits are too. We’ve designed them to give you the security, flexibility, and opportunities you need to focus on what matters most.

title: Donor Officer
description:
To support our mission and operational structure, we are only able to hire team members who are already authorized to work in the Unites States. Candidates MUST have existing legal work authorization, as visa sponsorship is not available.
We are looking for someone located in the Central or Eastern parts of the US.
About Our Mission
Greater Europe Mission is a community of disciple-makers that longs to see Europe transformed by Jesus. For over 70 years, our workers have created relationships and environments of grace where people who are near or far from God feel welcome.
On a continent where less than 3% of the population claim a relationship with Jesus, the light of the gospel is spreading! As more and more Europeans are awakened to hope in Jesus, the need for effective, reproducible discipleship is at an all time high.
Our US-based team works to connect the people of God in the US to the mission of God in Europe through recruiting, creating church partnerships, and raising funds to support the ministry.
Position Summary: ( This is a remote position )
The Donor Officer serves on the GEM US Development team with responsibility for building, cultivating, and stewarding relationships with donors and prospects in order to advance the mission of Greater Europe Mission . The ideal candidate has experience in recruiting, sales, or donor development. They are passionate about building new relationships and working alongside a team that is enthusiastic about the mission field of Europe.
GENERAL RESPONSIBILITIES FOR ALL GEM STAFF

• Maintain personal spiritual vitality and a healthy life rhythm.

• Live and work in alignment with GEM’s mission, vision, and core values.

• Participate in required staff meetings, retreats, and organizational gatherings.

• Communicate in a timely, professional, and gracious manner with colleagues, donors, and partners.

• Uphold GEM policies, procedures, and standards of confidentiality and integrity.
SPECIFIC RESPONSIBILITIES
Donor Care & Relationship Management

• Manage an assigned caseload of donors and prospects, focusing on cultivation, solicitation, and stewardship.

• Conduct regular donor visits and relational touchpoints (in person, phone, and virtual).

• Encourage deeper donor engagement by clearly communicating GEM’s mission, vision, and ministry impact in Europe.

• Identify and help qualify new donor prospects in collaboration with the Development team.
Stewardship & Engagement

• Ensure donors receive timely, thoughtful communication and understand the impact of their generosity.

• Partner with Marketing, field leadership, and missionaries to share stories, updates, and giving opportunities.

• Participate in donor events and gatherings such as Vision Summit, Vision Weekend, and regional or small-group events.

• Maintain accurate donor records, notes, and follow-up in GEM’s CRM.
Team Collaboration

• Work closely with the VP of Development and Development team to support fundraising strategies and goals.

• Contribute to a team-based culture of donor care, accountability, and collaboration.

• Support organizational fundraising initiatives as needed.
TRAVEL
This position requires up to 50% travel. Some of the travel is international.
QUALIFICATIONS
Required

• Clear Christian faith and personal alignment with GEM’s mission and values.

• 3-5 years of relevant experience in development, fundraising, sales, and/or recruiting, with demonstrated strength in relationship-building.

• Strong interpersonal and communication skills, both written and verbal.

• Ability to manage multiple relationships, priorities, and follow-up effectively.

• Willingness and ability to travel for donor visits and events.
Preferred

• Experience managing a donor portfolio or working in major or mid-level giving.

• Experience in a nonprofit, ministry, or mission-sending organization.

• Familiarity with CRM systems and donor tracking.

title: Contract Writer - A Book For Women Struggling with People-Pleasing
description:
Location: Remote
Position Overview
We are seeking a contract writer to develop and write a Christ-centered book focused on helping women overcome people-pleasing. This project will help women unmask the root causes of approval-seeking behaviors, dismantle the fear of man, and live in the genuine freedom of a heart captivated by the fear of God.
We are open to different conceptual directions for this resource, including:

• A foundational, theological exploration of the "fear of man" vs. the "fear of God." This book would dive deep into theology to uncover how a woman's craving for human approval is ultimately a worship issue. It would offer a robust, gospel-centered framework for understanding our identity in Christ, freeing women from the exhausting, performance-driven cycle of earning love and acceptance.

• A vulnerable, narrative-driven book that uses powerful personal storytelling, memoir-style reflection, and relatable lived experiences to expose the daily, heavy toll of people-pleasing. title: Senior Full-Stack TypeScript Engineer
description:
Seeking a senior full-stack TypeScript engineer to construct the web platform through which enterprise users manage our multi-tenant control plane powering AI infrastructure. Main Responsibilities:

• Build product features end to end in a modern Next.js and React application - server components, route handlers, client interactivity, and the data layer that connects them.

• Develop and extend the shared component library and design tokens, implementing Figma specs faithfully across light and dark themes.

• Own the server tier that sits between the browser and the platform: request proxying, session handling, and keeping backend service URLs and credentials securely off the client.

• Implement authentication and authorization in the web tier - OIDC login against the platform auth service, JWT claim verification, session expiry, and role-based UI gating that mirrors platform permissions.

• Maintain the generated TypeScript SDK produced from the platform's OpenAPI specification, including the codegen pipeline, compatibility gates, and drift detection against the live API.

• Write tests at every level - component tests with mocked network behavior, and Playwright end-to-end suites that run against live environments.

• Ensure accessibility, responsive behavior, and optimal web performance (bundle size, render cost, and what ships to the browser on each route).

• Instrument the application for production: error tracking, product analytics, feature flags, and structured logging.

• Review peers' code, debug production issues to root cause with regression coverage, and mentor junior engineers through design reviews.

Required Skills/Abilities:

• 8+ years of professional software engineering, including deep production experience with TypeScript and modern React paradigms.

• Next.js architecture mastery: deep understanding of the server/client component boundary, caching strategies, and server-side rendering.

• Genuine full-stack range: comfortable and secure owning server-side code and API proxies, not just browser-based logic.

• Practical web-tier security experience: implementing OAuth2/OIDC flows, JWT verification, and secure cookie/session management.

• Architectural fluency in managing complex application state, specifically bridging server-state synchronization with client UI updates.

• Strong CSS architecture and design-system practice - utility-first CSS, scalable theming, and accessible component APIs built on headless primitives.

• Testing discipline across unit, component, and end-to-end layers, including network mocking and CI integration.

Salonkee ist Marktführer für Salon-Software in Luxemburg, Belgien und der Schweiz. Über 10.000 Beauty- und Wellness-Betriebe in sieben Ländern nutzen unsere All-in-one-Software - von der Terminbuchung über die Kundenverwaltung und die Kasse bis hin zu Marketing- und KI-Funktionen.

Für einen Salon bedeutet das im Schnitt 70 % weniger Terminausfälle und 8 bis 12 Stunden weniger Verwaltungsaufwand pro Woche.

DEINE ROLLE

- Du gehst aktiv auf Saloninhaber:innen in deiner Region zu - telefonisch, per Walk-in oder über Social Media (Kaltakquise).

- Vor Ort ermittelst du den Bedarf des Salons mithilfe von Fragen und zeigst anhand von Produktdemos, wie Salonkee den Alltag vereinfachen kann.

- Du verantwortest deinen eigenen Funnel vom Erstkontakt bis zum Abschluss.

- Du planst deine Woche eigenverantwortlich, mit klaren Zielen und einer Führungskraft, die dich unterstützt und weiterentwickelt.

DAS BRINGST DU MIT

- Vertriebserfahrung ist nicht unbedingt notwendig. Wenn du aus dem Hospitality, Beauty, Retail, Fitness, Event oder einem anderen Bereich mit viel Kundenkontakt kommst, bringst du das Wichtigste schon mit.

- Du bist kontaktfreudig und gehst gerne in den Austausch - egal ob am Telefon oder direkt vor Ort.

- Du bist in der Lage, Menschen zu begeistern und Interessen zu wecken.

- Du kannst mit Ablehnung umgehen und richtest den Blick nach vorn.

- Du bist lernbereit, setzt Feedback um und willst dich weiterentwickeln.

- Du bist strukturiert und organisiert.

- Du bist sicher im Umgang mit digitalen Tools.

- Verhandlungssicheres bis muttersprachliches Deutsch sowie gute Englischkenntnisse.

- Führerschein der Klasse B und Freude daran, in deiner Region unterwegs zu sein.

DAS ERWARTET DICH BEI UNS

- Vertrieb von Grund auf lernen: Bootcamp zum Start, gezieltes Ramp-Up Programm, Shadowing bei erfahrenen Kolleg:innen, Roleplays und regelmäßiges Coaching.

- Ein Team vor Ort: Team Lead und Kolleg:innen in deiner Region - du startest nicht allein.

- Ein klarer Entwicklungspfad: Von Junior- über Senior- und bis hin zu Führungsrollen.

- Klare KPIs & Performance-Transparenz, damit du jederzeit weißt, wo du stehst.

- Eigenverantwortliche Wochenplanung und Vertrauensarbeitszeit.

- Firmenwagen inkl. Tankkarte sowie MacBook und iPhone.

- 50 € steuerfreies Guthaben pro Monat über Probonio.

- Fixgehalt und ungedeckelte Provision.

- Teamevents, die den Namen verdienen: Sommerfest, Winterfeier und regelmäßige Team-Formate.

WIE GEHT ES WEITER?

1. Bewerbung & Sichtung - wir melden uns so schnell wie möglich bei dir.

2. Erstgespräch mit unserem Recruiting-Team (ca. 30-45 Minuten).

3. Video-Call mit deiner künftigen Führungskraft.

4. Field Day - zwei Stunden bei uns im Office. Du siehst, wie wir arbeiten, wir sehen dich in Aktion.

5. Abschlussgespräch mit unserer Head of Sales.

Salonkee steht für Chancengleichheit und Vielfalt. Wir freuen uns über Bewerbungen von Menschen mit unterschiedlichen Hintergründen, Perspektiven und Fähigkeiten - unabhängig von Geschlecht, Herkunft, Alter, Behinderung, Religion oder Identität.

title: Virtual Property Manager
description:
We're looking for a Virtual Property Manager to oversee day-to-day operations across a growing residential real estate portfolio. You will be the operational point of contact for tenants, vendors, and contractors - managing maintenance coordination, rent collection follow-ups, leasing support, move-ins and move-outs, and all the documentation and communication that keeps a multi-property portfolio running cleanly.
This role has a hard language requirement. You must be fully fluent in both English and Spanish, written and spoken. A significant portion of tenant and vendor communication happens in Spanish and there is no workaround for this. If you are highly organized, genuinely bilingual, comfortable handling difficult conversations professionally, and take pride in keeping operations tight across multiple moving parts, this role is a strong fit.
Why You'll Want to Join

• You will be paid in USD (bi-monthly: every 15th and 30th)

•
Paid Time Off in accordance with company policy

• Observance of Holidays per company guidelines

•
100% remote setup so you can work wherever you're most productive

• This role requires availability during US Pacific Time business hours

• Work directly with ownership on a growing residential portfolio with real operational ownership

• Stable, long-term role with clear responsibilities and room to grow as the portfolio scales

What You'll Work On
Tenant Communication and Support

• Respond to tenant inquiries via phone, text, email, and WhatsApp in both English and Spanish

• Handle difficult tenant conversations professionally and with a solutions-first approach

• Communicate with Section 8 and Housing Authority representatives as needed

• Assist with leasing coordination and tenant screening

Maintenance and Vendor Coordination

• Coordinate maintenance requests and follow up with vendors and contractors through to resolution

• Track open work orders and ensure nothing falls through the cracks

• Help source and manage vendors for repairs and renovations

• Escalate urgent property issues quickly and keep ownership informed

Leasing and Turnover Operations

• Coordinate move-ins, move-outs, inspections, and unit turnovers

• Assist with rent collection and payment follow-ups

• Maintain organized property records, leases, invoices, and tenant documentation

Systems, Reporting, and Automation

• Keep property management software, spreadsheets, and internal systems accurate and up to date

• Support ownership with operational reporting and administrative tasks

• Apply a fundamental understanding of multi-entity accounting including tracking income, expenses, intercompany transactions, and financial activity across multiple LLCs and properties

• Use AI tools and automation platforms to improve efficiency and streamline recurring workflows

What You Bring

• Full professional fluency in both English and Spanish, written and spoken - this is a non-negotiable requirement

• Prior experience in property management, real estate operations, or a closely related role

• Fundamental understanding of multi-entity accounting and tracking financial activity across multiple properties or business entities

• Strong organizational and multitasking skills with the ability to manage multiple open items simultaneously without dropping the ball

• Excellent communication and follow-through across phone, text, email, and messaging platforms

• Comfortable handling difficult tenant conversations professionally and calmly

• Experience coordinating maintenance vendors and contractors

• Tech-savvy with the ability to learn new systems quickly

• Reliable internet connection and a quiet, professional work environment

• Available to work during US Pacific Time business hours

Nice to Have

• Experience with DoorLoop, Buildium, or similar property management software

• Experience working with Section 8 or affordable housing programs

• Experience managing remote vendors or contractors across multiple properties

title: Project Manager II (Poland)
description:
Description
The project manager II has the overall responsibility for the successful initiation, planning, execution, monitoring, controlling and closure of assigned clinical trials. The project manager II oversees and coordinates study resources to ensure compliance with the study budget, project scope and timelines and in accordance with applicable standard operating procedures (SOPs), good clinical practices, regulatory and study-specific requirements. Project Manager II acts as the main line of communication to relevant stakeholders and provides input to feasibility, study design, budget development and ensures progress reporting (resources, budget and timeline)
This role will be perfect for you if:

• You want to work for a mid-sized CRO that works on significant multisite trials, including Global Phase III projects

• You are looking to position yourself in an environment where you can grow your career alongside the company

IMPACT AND RESPONSIBILITIES
﻿Client interactions

• Serve as primary contact for the Sponsor

• Provide efficient and timely updates on trial progress

• Lead client calls effectively

Project planning

• Oversee and actively participates in the preparation of project deliverables such as; study plans, protocol, informed consent form, electronic case report form (eCRF), tables/listings/figures (TLFs), clinical study report.

• Participate in the planning and conduct of the Investigator’s Meeting.

• Ensure that each site has the necessary material to adequately perform the study (e.g., investigational product, study supplies, special equipment, safety lab kits, etc.).

• Lead study start-up activities including trial kick-off, TMF setup, site selection and activation, vendor set-up timelines, and site contracting and budgeting.

• Collaborate with Regulatory Affairs to ensure timely submissions and completeness of essential documents prior to site initiation and throughout the study.

• Partner with Data Management to ensure CRF alignment with protocol and sponsor requirements, and that data review, query resolution, and database lock timelines are met.

Quality and risk management

• Ensure assigned studies are “audit ready” at all times.

• Monitor the quality of study deliverables, (including vendor and SubCRO deliverables) and address issues as they arise.

• Manage risk and control measures to assure project quality.

• Analyze discrepancies between planned and actual results.

• Review and approve responses to quality assurance audits.

Project budget and timelines

• Control the project budget, with particular attention to internal hours allocated to all activities.

• Identify out of scope activities for change orders.

• Proactively manage operational aspects of the clinical trial including trial timelines, budget, resources and vendors. Coordinate tasks and deliverables from all functional departments involved in the project.

• Communicate effectively with study team members, functional departments, and senior management.

• Manage and report on recruitment status and highlight initiatives needed to meet recruitment timelines.

Project team leadership

We’re building a world of health around every individual - shaping a more connected, convenient and compassionate health experience. At CVS Health®, you’ll be surrounded by passionate colleagues who care deeply, innovate with purpose, hold ourselves accountable and prioritize safety and quality in everything we do. Join us and be part of something bigger - helping to simplify health care one person, one family and one community at a time.
Do you have a passion for engaging with people and helping them on their journey to better health? Signify Health, part of CVS Health®, is seeking a Per Diem Physician to provide In-Home Health Evaluations, engaging with people in the comfort of their own homes and helping bridge gaps in care.
You’ll play a critical role in building trusted relationships to make people healthier, helping bring flexible, comprehensive and personalized health evaluations right to people’s front doors.
Job highlights
The visit, which lasts about 45 minutes, allows for time to connect one-on-one and answer health questions. It includes a medication and medical history review, a physical evaluation, and, if ordered by the person’s health plan, additional diagnostic tests (i.e., diabetic eye exams, spirometry, etc.). You’ll use an iPad and an intuitive clinical workflow for each evaluation and are not required to prescribe medicine, order lab tests or alter people’s current treatment regimen.
In this role, you will:

• Bring your heart into every visit, joining a national network of purpose-driven clinicians dedicated to improving health outcomes

• Be part of our efforts to visit millions of people nationwide with the goal of providing connections to the right care for people’s unique needs

• Work with Signify Health as a clinician colleague, fulfilling the requirements of the specified role

• Conduct virtual visits as needed

• Provide all Signify Health services as indicated including Diagnostic & Preventive Services products (i.e., spirometry, DEE, bone density screening, etc.)

A Note on Our Work Environment:
As an in-home clinician, your primary workplace is the private residence of health plan members. We are dedicated to meeting health plan members where they are, wherever they call home. These environments are diverse and may present a variety of conditions. Candidates must be able to comfortably and safely perform their duties in homes that may contain household pets, secondhand smoke and other potential airborne allergens or irritants.
Why Clinicians Enjoy Working with Signify Health
“Many of the people I see are shocked that a physician is coming to their home to visit with them one-on-one. When you sit down and have an unhurried conversation about their health, they are impressed, happy, and understand that their health plan and care team cares about them.” - M.L., MD
“The primary care physician gets a snapshot of a person in an office setting, but with Signify Health, we see things like the number of steps to enter their home, the state of disrepair those steps may be in, and the person’s ability to function comfortably and with ease in their own home. We can make referrals to the individual’s health plan, encourage the participation of their loved ones, and ensure their PCPs are aware of their health and overall quality of life.” - C.H., MD
Per diem employees qualify for:

• Hourly base rate, plus additional incentive structure (i.e., per visit completed, other incentives may apply)

• Malpractice insurance coverage (during Signify Health-related activities)

• Supplies and other perks

• Active, unrestricted license(s) in coverage area(s)

• Multi-state licenses (preferred)

12 Time

title: Senior QA Engineer (Manual & Automation)
description:
Salla is looking for a Senior QA Engineer to take ownership of product quality across our platform. In this role, you will be responsible for ensuring that every release meets our quality standards, and you will be accountable for making informed go/no-go release decisions based on risk and test results.
You will be expected to define the most suitable QA approach for our product and teams, including the testing strategy, tools, standards, and workflows. This approach should be flexible, not rigid: you will adapt the depth, type, and process of testing to fit each situation, whether it's an urgent hotfix, a major feature launch, or a high-risk change.
This is a hands-on role covering both manual and automated testing. You will work closely with engineering, product, and DevOps teams to review requirements, define test strategies, perform manual and exploratory testing, and build reliable test automation using Playwright.
Beyond identifying and resolving defects, you will analyze their root causes and implement preventive measures to reduce recurring issues.
Responsibilities

• Own quality end to end, building it in early through requirement reviews, design discussions, and test strategy, through to the final go/no-go call on releases

• Define and continuously refine the QA approach, including testing standards, workflows, tools, and quality metrics. Adapt testing depth, process, and priorities to risk, timeline, and context rather than applying a one-size-fits-all process

• Decide what needs testing, how deeply, and with which approach (functional, regression, API, UI, performance, security, usability). Decide what stays manual and what gets automated, and know when enough is enough

• Perform thorough manual and exploratory testing on new features, finding what scripts miss: edge cases, unexpected user behavior, UX problems, and the UI details users notice (layout, states, responsiveness)

• Build and maintain Playwright (TypeScript/JavaScript) automation that runs in CI, catches real issues instead of just adding to a test count, and gives the team fast, trustworthy feedback

• Review code and pull requests properly: read them, question them, and push back when something isn't right

• Triage defects and investigate them in depth using browser DevTools (network, console, performance, storage) to find root causes, not just symptoms, and help the team prioritize what matters most

• Prevent recurring issues by identifying the pattern behind bugs, analyzing defect trends, and putting safeguards in place (tests, checks, process changes). Think ahead about how new features, scale, and changes will affect quality

• Use AI tools thoughtfully to speed up test creation, analysis, and debugging, and build AI-assisted workflows where they add value, while always validating the output

• Communicate risks clearly to developers, product managers, and leadership, with a recommendation rather than just a report

• Take initiative to spot gaps in our processes, tools, or product and drive improvements, while mentoring other QA engineers and raising the quality mindset across the team

Requirements

• 5+ years of QA experience with real ownership of releases and quality decisions

• Strong experience in both manual and automated testing, and the judgment to balance the two

• Solid JavaScript and TypeScript skills, enough to write clean, maintainable Playwright automation and read application code with confidence

• Hands-on experience with Playwright (or strong experience with a similar framework plus a willingness to go deep on Playwright)

• Strong command of Git and GitHub: branching, pull requests, code reviews, and working within CI pipelines

• Deep understanding of testing types, techniques, and test design, and the judgment to choose the right one

• Flexibility to adjust your approach to different situations, avoiding rigid processes while keeping quality standards high

• Experience testing web, mobile, and APIs

• Comfort with

title: Regional People Partner
description:
CLEAR is building THE secure identity company of the future. Our mission is to make experiences safer and easier-physically and digitally. With more than 43 million Members and a growing network of partners across the world, CLEAR's secure identity platform is transforming the way people live, work, and travel. Whether it’s at the airport, stadium, or throughout your everyday life, CLEAR unlocks the magic of frictionless experiences.

The Regional People Partner is the key connective tissue between our Airport Operations leaders and their teams. Across your region, you're the person leaders lean on to make good calls, and the person team members know is invested in their success. This role puts you in the middle of it all: coaching station leaders, solving employee relations issues, and building exceptional team member experience that help CLEAR thrive.

 

What you'll do:

• Be the go-to People Partner for Operations leaders in your region - the person they call when something's tricky, not just when something's already broken.

• Coach and sharpen station leaders and managers - through training, real feedback, recognition that means something, and just showing up when it counts.

• Own employee and labor relations across your stations: run investigations, dig into root causes, and land on outcomes that are fair and consistent, working closely with Legal along the way.

• Turn employee data, survey results, and what you're hearing on the ground into recommendations leaders can actually act on.

• Partner across People and Operations on the bigger initiatives: onboarding, process fixes, and making sure People practices run the same way at every station.

 

How you'll measure success:

• Fewer repeat employee relations issues, and faster, smarter resolution when they do come up.

• Engagement and retention trending up across the airport teams you support.

• Leaders and managers putting the training and programs you build to real use.

• People processes running consistently at every station in your region.

 

What you're great at:

• 5+ years of HR or People Business Partner experience, including real time supporting hourly or frontline teams and handling complex employee relations matters.

• Earning trust with operational leaders quickly, and coaching them through hard calls with good judgment and empathy.

• Reading data and what people are actually telling you, then turning both into action.

• Juggling a lot at once without losing the thread, in an environment that shifts week to week.

• Communicating clearly at every level - whether that's a one-on-one coaching conversation or a room full of station leaders.

• Being on the ground: this is an in-operation role based out of Denver International Airport (DEN), with anticipated travel of up to 50%.

 

How You'll be Rewarded:

At CLEAR, we help YOU move forward - because when you’re at your best, we’re at our best. You’ll work with talented team members motivated by our mission of making experiences safer and easier. Our offices are bright and energetic with an open concept and plenty of conference rooms and casual co-working spaces. We also offer catered lunches every day and have fully stocked kitchens. Outside of the office, we invest in your well-being and learning & development with stipends and reimbursement programs. 

We offer holistic total rewards, including comprehensive healthcare plans, family-building benefits (fertility and adoption/surrogacy support), flexible time off, annual wellness stipend, free OneMedical memberships for you and your dependents, a CLEAR Plus membership, and a 401(k) retirement plan with employer match. The base salary range depends on levels of skills and experience.

title: Vice President FP&A
description:
ABOUT OLIPOP

At OLIPOP, we’re on a mission to positively impact consumer health at scale. And we’re doing it through something simple: soda. But not just any soda, a new kind of soda: one that’s delicious, refreshing, and actually good for you.

This mission is deeply personal for our CEO, Co-Founder, and Formulator, Ben Goodwin. Like many of us, Ben grew up consuming the Standard American Diet: lots of soda and processed foods that prioritized convenience over nutrition. But at 14, he took his health into his own hands. After making significant changes to his nutrition and exercise, he lost 50 pounds and saw a transformation in his energy, mood, and emotional clarity.

Those changes sparked a deep curiosity about the connection between nutrition and health. Ben became a relentless student of the gut microbiome and the ways it supports overall wellness. The more he discovered, the more passionate he became about finding credible, science-backed ways to make consumer health accessible to everyone.

The mission was clear. The vehicle? Less so. After exploring the possibilities, Ben landed on an unexpected yet familiar choice: soda. It was something he loved as a kid, and he knew millions shared that same nostalgia. But this wouldn’t be just any soda. With most Americans falling short on daily fiber, Ben set out to create a version with more fiber and less sugar, one that was perfectly balanced. The result? A deliciously refreshing soda with 6 to 9 grams of fiber and 2 to 5 grams of sugar, delivering science-backed benefits without sacrificing the classic taste people crave.

In 2018, the first OLIPOP cans hit the shelves, bringing Ben’s vision to life with a functional soda that anyone could enjoy. And by reimagining soda, we’re also reshaping culture. That means creating products that support health for all and building a business grounded in humanistic values: empathy, integrity, and a belief in better for everyone. From the ingredients we source to the culture we foster, we’re committed to proving that business (and beverage!) can be a force for good, and that soda has the power to bring people together.

So join us, and let’s write a new American soda story together. One we can all feel good about. One OLIPOP at a time.

title: Engineering Manager, Issuing Platform
description:
ABOUT AIRWALLEX

Airwallex is the AI-native financial operating system for a real-time, intelligent economy. More than 675,000 businesses, including McLaren Racing, Qantas, SHEIN, and TikTok, use us, directly or through our platform partners, to run their financial operations or build and monetize financial products of their own.

We started in Melbourne in 2015 to build the infrastructure global commerce runs on. We're the regulated backbone behind global payments: not by accident, but by design. A decade plus, 85+ licenses, and a financial infrastructure spanning North America, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific.

We're co-headquartered in San Francisco and Singapore, with more than 2,300 people across 27 offices. We hire builders with founder-level energy, people who move fast with good judgment, dig in with real curiosity, and make calls from first principles rather than waiting to be told what to do. Read our operating principles https://www.airwallex.com/en-us/operating-principles to see it in full.

 

HOW YOU'LL MAKE IMPACT

As an Engineering Manager, Issuing Platform, you’ll lead one or more teams building and operating the core systems behind Airwallex’s issuing products, including card lifecycle management, high-throughput transaction processing, and clearance, settlement, and dispute workflows. You’ll combine people leadership, technical direction, and delivery ownership to help your teams build reliable, scalable systems for high-stakes financial workflows.

You’ll remain technically credible and engaged at an architectural level while focusing primarily on team health, execution, and long-term technical quality rather than acting as the primary individual contributor. You’ll partner with product, operations, senior engineers, and other engineering leaders to improve reliability, observability, security, developer productivity, and cost efficiency across the platform.

- Own team health, execution, and long-term technical quality across one or more engineering teams.

- Build a strong engineering culture through coaching, feedback, performance management, career development, hiring, and onboarding.

- Drive technical direction and architectural guidance for scalable, resilient transaction-processing systems.

- Improve system design, code quality, testing, reliability, observability, security, and operational excellence across the platform.

- Partner with product, operations, senior engineers, and other engineering leaders to align technical and delivery strategy with business priorities.

- Guide pragmatic technology and platform decisions that balance innovation, stability, developer productivity, and cost efficiency.

This is an in-office role - you’ll be in our Singapore office five days a week.

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

Essentials

- 10+ years of professional software engineering experience, with at least 2+ years in a people leadership role managing engineers directly.

- Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field.

- Strong background in modern backend development using languages such as Java, Kotlin, Go, or Python.

- Proven experience designing and delivering large-scale, distributed, production systems.

- Solid understanding of computer science fundamentals and object-oriented design principles.

- Hands-on experience with event-driven and streaming architectures, for example Kafka.

- Experience designing and operating RESTful APIs at scale.

- Cloud experience with GCP (preferred) or AWS, including containerized workloads using Docker and Kubernetes.

- Familiarity with observability and operational tooling such as Splunk, Grafana, and Prometheus.

- Demonstrated ability to mentor engineers and lead the execution of technical and delivery strategy.

Preferred

- Experience in fintech, payments, or other regulated financial domains.

- Deep experience with JVM-based ecosystems, including Java or Kotlin with Spring or Spring Boot.

title: Customer Solutions Engineer, EMEA
description:
Headquarters: Remote - Ireland

About the Role

Abnormal AI is looking for a Customer Solutions Engineer to join the Technical Account Management team. This role gives Abnormal a flexible, technical resource for situations that fall between standard support and a long-term, dedicated Technical Account Manager. Customer Solutions Engineers are floating technical specialists who partner with CSMs for the duration of a specific need, triggered by things like recurring support cases, asks beyond the typical support experience, or short-term project-based work. The ideal candidate combines deep technical fluency with strong triage judgment and is comfortable moving between engagements without an existing playbook.

What you will do 

• Serve as a flexible technical resource CSMs can bring into challenging or recurring account situations that a standard support case isn't built to resolve.

• Take on short-term, project-based technical engagements for customers without a dedicated TAM.

• Partner with CSMs to assess customer technical needs, join investigative or best-practices calls, and determine the right next step.

• Lead hands-on platform optimization: configuration reviews, best-practices setup, and proactive tuning that prevents issues from recurring.

• Document session recaps and next steps in the CRM so recommendations are clear to the customer and visible to the broader team.

• Advise customers on underused contracted features and flag upsell or professional services/deployment opportunities where relevant.

• Recognize when a situation exceeds this role's scope and hand it to the Critical Situation Manager or Technical Support with a clear, documented hand-off.

• Surface patterns across engagements

title: Senior Post Producer (m/w/d)
description:
About WPP Production

We are WPP Production - the unified global production company that brings together all of WPP's content producers, studios and craft experts into one connected organisation. We combine world-class human craft with next generation technology to originate, design, and deliver multi-channel content systems at scale. Built for borderless collaboration and powered by deep craft expertise, we are the production engine designed for today's always on, AI driven marketing world.

About WPP

WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company - powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. For more information, visit  WPP.com .

Was macht ein Senior Post Producer (m/w/d) bei WPP Production?

Als Senior Post Producer (m/w/d) steuerst Du eigenverantwortlich den gesamten Post-Produktionsprozess von Werbefilmen - von der Budgetierung und Ressourcenplanung für Schnitt, VFX, Grading und Audio-Finishing bis hin zur Einhaltung strenger Zeitpläne. Als zentrale Schnittstelle zwischen Kunde, Agentur und Produktion führst Du souverän durch alle Abnahmeschleifen und stellt die fristgerechte sowie technisch einwandfreie Auslieferung der finalen Master sicher.

 

Deine Aufgaben

• Eigenverantwortliche Erstellung, Führung und Nachkalkulation komplexer Budgets; Erfahrung in der Nachverhandlung von Change Requests und Scope-Erweiterungen

• Steuerung paralleler Projekte, Booking und Führung von Schnittplätzen, Grading-Suites, Tonstudios sowie In-House- & Freelance-Artisten unter hohem Zeitdruck

• Souveräne Führung von Abnahme-Sessions (Offline/Online-Abnahmen, Sound-Laydowns) mit Regie, Kreativdirektion, Agenturen und Endkunden

Das bringst du mit

• Mehrjährige, einschlägige Erfahrung in der Post-Produktion von Werbefilmen (in einer Post-Production-Agency, Werbefilmproduktion oder Werbeagentur)

• Abgeschlossenes Studium im Bereich Medienproduktion/Film, kaufmännische Ausbildung im Medienbereich oder vergleichbare fundierte Branchenerfahrung

• Exzellentes Verständnis der gesamten Post-Kette: Schnitt (Offline/Online), VFX/CGI, Color Grading, Motion Design, Mastering und Audio/Sounddesign

• Sicherer Umgang mit Post-Management-Tools (z. B. Frame.io) sowie solides Verständnis von NLEs und Suite-Standards (Adobe Creative Cloud, DaVinci Resolve)

• Fundierte Kenntnisse zu Master-Deliverables, Social-Media-Formatierungen (9:16, 4:5, 1:1), TV-Spezifikationen

• Hohe Belastbarkeit und Gelassenheit in engen Timelines, schnelle Lösungsfindung bei unvorhergesehenen Revisionsschleifen oder technischen Engpässen

• Feingefühl im Erwartungsmanagement zwischen kreativen Ansprüchen der Regie/Agentur und kommerziellen/zeitlichen Rahmenbedingungen

• Verhandlungssichere Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift (inkl. branchenspezifischer Fachbegriffe)

Das bieten wir 

Bei uns findest du nicht nur spannende Aufgaben, sondern auch ein Arbeitsumfeld, das deine Entwicklung, Flexibilität und dein Wohlbefinden in den Mittelpunkt stellt. Entdecke unsere vielfältigen Vorteile:

 

• Arbeitskultur & Perspektiven:

• Spannende, vielseitige Projekte in einem schnell wachsenden, internationalen Unternehmen

• Offene Vertrauenskultur mit flachen Hierarchien und viel Raum für Eigenverantwortung

• Regelmäßige Feedback-Gespräche zur Talentförderung und Karriereentwicklung.

• Umfassende Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten über unser globales WPP Netzwerk (Trainings, Webinare, E-Learning)

 

• Flexibilität & Work-Life-Balance:

• Hybrid Working und flexible Arbeitszeiten

This position is a part of our WellSky Home team. We invite you to apply today and join us in shaping the future of healthcare!

• Collaborate with solutions teams to bring clinician, caregiver, administrator, operational, and performance perspectives into solution design, roadmap, and prioritization decisions.

title: Senior Solution Engineer - GCC
description:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset - who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

We are looking for world-class Solution Engineers to join our Global field teams whose technical skills and customer savvy will help customers understand and utilise the value of the cutting-edge data platform that we are building. They must share our passion about reinventing the data platform and thrive in a dynamic environment.

The Solution Engineer will work hand-in-hand with Sales, Product, Engineering, and Marketing. In this role you will work directly with the account sales team on a handful of global accounts with GCCs in India to accelerate their Snowflake journey. The Solution Engineer will be responsible for providing the technical expertise to make Snowflake customers successful in driving existing projects and uncover new use cases. This data architect will have a broad range of skills and experience ranging from data architecture to ETL/ELT, data science, security, performance analysis, analytics, etc. He/she will have the insight to make the connection between a customer’s specific business problems and Snowflake’s solution, the customer-facing skills to communicate that connection and vision to a wide variety of technical and executive audiences, and the technical skills to be able to not only build demos and execute proof-of-concepts but also to provide consultative assistance on architecture and implementation.

The Solution Engineer has the willingness to jump in and do what it takes to make Snowflake and our customers successful. - Be an advocate and develop mutual trust with the technical audience on the customer side

- Run training sessions, workshops, webinars to help customers become proficient in Snowflake

- Keeping customers up to date on key Snowflake product updates and future roadmaps to help them represent Snowflake to their clients about latest technology solutions and benefits

- Run technical enablement programs to provide best practices, and solution design workshops to help customers create effective solutions

- Create and develop technical champions in your accounts to drive Snowflake adoption

- Represent Snowflake at customer or industry events

title: Director of Demand Generation
description:
About commercetools

Real innovation starts with a strong foundation, and at commercetools, that comes from the perfect balance of our product and our people.

Behind every leap forward is a collective of builders, explorers, doers, makers, and problem-solvers.The kind of people who not only pioneered a more flexible approach to commerce architecture but also shaped the culture of experimentation that approach unlocked. Together they are the engine of commerce innovation today.

At commercetools, we power the next era of autonomous commerce for our customers. Whether it’s AI-driven solutions that help enterprises make smarter business decisions, bridging digital and physical shopping experiences, or enabling entirely new ways for industries to connect with their customers, we help the world’s most ambitious companies experiment, scale, and grow without limits.

Here the best idea wins, not the loudest voice. You will have the tools, trust, and space to not only build the future of commerce, but to build your own.

Your Impact

As our Director of Demand Generation , you’ll support the Marketing team by owning the global strategy and execution for generating pipeline across our target enterprise accounts. Leading a multi-disciplinary team spanning Digital Marketing, ABX, Field & Regional Marketing, Corporate Events, and Web Experience, you will partner closely with Sales and Revenue Operations to turn demand into predictable revenue.

You will:

• Strategic Growth Leadership: Design and execute an integrated, multi-channel global demand engine aligned with corporate ARR targets, market expansion goals, and key enterprise ICPs.

• Team Scaling & Management: Lead, mentor, and expand a high-performing global team across ABX, Field Marketing, Digital, Web, and Events-fostering a culture of experimentation, accountability, and commercial excellence.

• Pipeline Acceleration & ABX: Architect targeted Account-Based Marketing strategies for enterprise accounts, driving both net-new logos and expansion within existing accounts across North America, EMEA, APAC, and LATAM.

• Full-Funnel Optimization: Establish a rigorous, data-driven approach to track end-to-end conversion rates, pipeline velocity, CAC, ROMI and marketing-attributed/influenced pipeline across all channels.

• Sales & GTM Alignment: Serve as a core partner to Global Sales leadership, unifying marketing targets with sales pipelines, optimizing lead-to-opportunity handoffs, and continuously aligning GTM execution.

• Leverage AI to Build for Scale: Identify opportunities to scale marketing programs and outcomes by implementing new ways-of-working supported by AI capabilities.

• Budget & Performance Ownership: Manage the global demand gen budget, making agile resource-allocation decisions backed by ROI analytics and attribution models.

This role is hybrid, with three days a week spent in our Boston or London office. 

What Sets You Apart

You're a creative problem-solver and systems builder who is wired to find solutions. You confidently dive into complex challenges and have a talent for making them simple for others. Your curiosity drives you to constantly grow and contribute to an environment of trust and teamwork.

Great ideas come from many paths, and your unique perspective matters more than checking every box. What matters most is the mindset you bring to the work.

You bring:

• Enterprise B2B Software Track Record: 10+ years of progressive demand generation leadership in enterprise B2B SaaS/software (experience in headless/composable commerce, middleware, or developer-centric infrastructure is a major plus).

• Global Team Leadership: Proven experience leading and inspiring remote, cross-functional GTM teams across multiple regions and time zones.

• Advanced ABX & Digital Native: Mastery of modern enterprise GTM plays, multi-touch attribution, data analytics, and modern martech stacks (CRM, Marketing Automation, Intent Data engines).

Resumen e Impacto del Rol

Este rol forma parte del equipo de Investment de WPP Media, donde entre otras cosas, estamos a cargo de las negociaciones y auditorías de un grupo de clientes clave para la agencia. Este cargo es una pieza fundamental en el control de márgenes y rentabilidad de medios propios, que se basan en los lineamientos definidos por la agencia.

• Capacidad para administrar los equipos de planificación/implementación para que las compras lleguen a los compromisos establecidos en el pitch

• Capacidad para llevar adelante auditorías regionales

Vida en WPP Media y Beneficios

Nuestra pasión por construir la nueva era de los medios cobra vida gracias a nuestro compromiso con Ser Extraordinarios ( Be Extraordinary ), invirtiendo en nuestra gente para inspirar una creatividad transformadora. También Lideramos con Optimismo ( Lead Optimistically ), creyendo firmemente e Impulsando el Crecimiento y Desarrollo ( Championing Growth and Development ) de cada persona. Este compromiso permite a nuestro equipo en WPP Media aprovechar la amplia red global de WPP Media y WPP para perseguir sus pasiones, construir conexiones profesionales clave y aprender en la vanguardia del marketing y la publicidad.

Creamos un Entorno Abierto ( Create an Open Environment ) basado en la confianza y el respeto, donde cada persona sienta que pertenece y tenga oportunidades reales de crecer. Esta cultura inclusiva se fomenta a través de diversos grupos de recursos para empleados (ERG) y eventos frecuentes en la oficina para destacar los logros del equipo, compartir liderazgo de pensamiento y celebrar fechas especiales e hitos importantes. Nuestro paquete integral de beneficios refleja este compromiso e incluye seguro médico, de visión y dental, planes grupales de retiro, un generoso programa de tiempo libre pagado, descuentos preferenciales con aliados y días dedicados al bienestar y la salud mental de nuestro equipo.

En WPP Media ofrecemos igualdad de oportunidades y consideramos todas las postulaciones sin discriminación. Creemos que el mejor trabajo surge cuando estamos juntos, potenciando la creatividad, la colaboración y la conexión en un entorno abierto y colaborativo. Por eso, hemos adoptado un modelo de trabajo híbrido. Si requieres alguna adaptación o flexibilidad, te invitamos a conversarlo con el equipo de selección durante el proceso de entrevista. Ten en cuenta que, si bien nuestra filosofía es la misma en todo WPP, los beneficios específicos pueden variar según la oficina o el país.

Por favor, consulta nuestro Aviso de Privacidad ( https://www.wppmedia.com/pages/privacy-policy ) para obtener más información sobre cómo procesamos la información que nos proporcionas.

Agradecemos a todas las personas que se postulen a esta vacante; sin embargo, solo contactaremos a los candidatos seleccionados para una entrevista.

title: Client Service Associate, Mutual Fund Service Desk
description:
Virtus is dedicated to the success of employees and helping everyone on our team achieve their goals.

We are a dynamic, fast-growing organization with the resources of a large firm and the innovative environment of an entrepreneurial company that promotes collaboration and employee engagement. Every member of our team is empowered to make a tangible impact in offering clients high-quality investment strategies to meet their financial needs and delivering value for our shareholders.

We are an organization where employees can thrive personally and professionally. Professional development opportunities help employees enhance their skills and grow in their careers. Meaningful financial rewards and a comprehensive package of benefits support employees at every stage of life and encourage work-life balance, and physical, emotional and mental well-being.

We believe in the value of a diverse, inclusive, and respectful work environment and are committed to making a positive impact in the communities where we live and work.

Benefits and Wellness

At Virtus, we believe that supporting our employees goes beyond the workplace. We offer competitive pay and a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your health, financial well-being, personal growth, and work-life balance. Benefits include medical, dental, and vision coverage beginning on your first day of employment, a 401(k) plan with a competitive company match and immediate vesting, company-paid life and disability insurance, supplemental insurance options, and a Health Savings Account with company contributions. Employees also have access to Flexible Spending Accounts, including Dependent Care FSA, a wellness program, tuition reimbursement, a 24/7 Employee Assistance Program, adoption assistance, paid family care time, and paid volunteer days, helping you thrive both professionally and personally.

Job Description
The Fund Services team is responsible for a variety of functions including client center and written communications; implementation of policies and procedures; oversight of Fund service providers and financial intermediaries; market timing analysis; reconciliation and reporting for financial intermediary sub transfer agency payments; preparation of fund announcements; and other regulatory tasks, as required. This role must be knowledgeable and trained to service multiple product lines including open-end and closed-end funds, college access savings, variable insurance funds, offshore mutual funds, and corporate stock clients.

Primary Job Responsibilities:

• Provide accurate, time-sensitive, and cost-effective services to our mutual funds, college access 529, and offshore clients as well as company stockholders, and intermediaries through inbound calls via the call center or written inquiries that enhance client service and contribute to the overall success of our business.

• Work closely with outsourced service providers (BNY Mellon, Computershare, Broadridge, etc.) to ensure adherence to high quality and quantity standards. Research and provide information on operational processes as required and ensure service providers’ policies and procedures are being followed.

• Draft policies and testing procedures to adhere to industry and compliance standards. Work closely with Mutual Fund Services management to ensure compliance and operational processes are developed and functional and that they satisfy new or changing corporate policies, SEC, FINRA, or other applicable industry or regulatory regulations.

• Provide ongoing research of the mutual fund industry to keep current with industry standards, laws, and regulations.

Ideal Qualifications:

• Bachelor's degree preferred.

• FINRA Series 6 required (within 6 months of hire).

• Mutual fund experience as well as transfer agency service provider expertise is preferred.

• Effective interpersonal communication skills (oral/written) with demonstrated ability to collaborate and positively influence diverse audiences

title: Remote Appointment Setter
description:
About Huzzle

At Huzzle , we connect exceptional talent with top opportunities at leading companies across the UK, US, Canada, Europe, and Australia. Our clients include fast-growing startups, digital agencies, SaaS companies, and tech-enabled businesses across industries such as MarTech, FinTech, EdTech, and eCommerce. Unlike traditional outsourcing agencies, we place you directly with innovative companies where you become a valued member of the team.
Job Summary
We are seeking a high-energy, resilient, and results-driven Remote Appointment Setter . In this role, you will be the engine of the sales pipeline, engaging directly with key decision-makers to spark interest and schedule high-value discovery calls. This is a high-volume outbound position designed for a professional who thrives on the hunt and understands that consistency is the key to unlocking massive revenue growth.
Key Responsibilities

• Execute high-volume outbound activity, maintaining a pace of 100+ calls per day.

• Prospect and qualify B2B leads to ensure a seamless handoff to the Account Executive team.

• Effectively navigate gatekeepers and reach decision-makers within target organizations.

• Manage a persistent follow-up cadence via phone and email to maximize conversion rates.

• Maintain clean and accurate records of all activity and lead intelligence within the CRM.

Requirements

• Proven experience in B2B sales or appointment setting.

• Demonstrated ability to maintain high call volumes (100+ daily dials) consistently.

• Exceptional verbal communication skills with a professional and persuasive phone presence.

• Strong "resilience muscle" and the ability to handle objections with poise.

• A dedicated, quiet home office setup with high-speed internet.

• Experience using modern sales engagement platforms and CRM tools.

• Background in technology or professional services sales.

• History of exceeding performance quotas in a remote environment.

Benefits
💰 Competitive base salary plus commission
🌎 Fully remote work environment
🛠️ Access to top-tier sales tools and technology
